fact: RNEP-GW, the Guinea-Bissau national research and education network, became a full member of WACREN (news item of 19 November 2024).
title: RNEP-GW Torna-se Membro Pleno da WACREN, Fortalecendo a Pesquisa e Educação na Guiné-Bissau
publisher: Rede Nacional de Ensino e Pesquisa da Guiné-Bissau (RNEP-GW)
